svg.aria-label: FixItNow — Home Services Marketplace. Customers book a technician for a time slot and pay with Stripe or SSLCommerz. Technicians manage their availability and jobs, and admins moderate the platform. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, TanStack Query, Stripe.
